items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: At the London House I went out there with Ja Jones, when he had a trio.

ctx.x: No, I'd have, I always took a tenor with me. I took a tenor. Most of the time it was Buddy Tate because Buddy and I had made so many records together. You know, Buck and Buddy, Buck and Buddy Blues.
At the London House I went out there with Ja Jones, when he had a trio. of..
